interpretation_hint: One thread of discussion: a single question, proposal or problem that people go back and forth on for several turns. Keep topics narrow: 'Whether to buy drip irrigation' and 'Who pays the water bill' are two topics, not one 'Garden watering'. A 30-minute working call usually has 5-8 topics. Not small talk, audio problems, greetings or scheduling. If the thread is already in `existing`, do not emit it again unless its summary or clarity changed; then emit it with its `id`. When the turns open a new thread inside the area of an existing broad topic, create a new DiscussionTopic for it.

properties.name: title
properties.interpretation_hint: Short label for the subject, 3-10 words.

properties.name: summary
properties.interpretation_hint: One or two sentences: what is being discussed, who holds which view, and where it stands now.

properties.name: clarity
properties.interpretation_hint: How clear the shared understanding is, judged from the whole exchange: low (people are confused, talk past each other, or the key question is open), medium, or high (everyone understands it the same way and agrees on what it means).
